product_one_liner.value: Eden provides a cloud-native medical imaging platform that combines PACS, radiology workflow management, image viewing, reporting and AI for imaging centers and radiologists.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the navigation or footer, and the checked /pricing URL returned no page; the site directs visitors to book a demo.

named_customers.notes: Both are featured in customer stories.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains marketing, industry guidance and product content, rather than two qualifying engineer-authored posts about building Eden.

public_docs.notes: Public API documentation includes articles covering authentication, orders, studies and scheduling.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Open role: Member of Technical Staff, AI Research – Radiology Foundation Model.

model_provider.value: Eden Cortex, Eden's radiology foundation model
model_provider.notes: Eden describes Cortex as generating complete radiology reports from medical images and adapting to radiologists' reporting styles.

compliance_certs.notes: These are publicly displayed compliance claims; HIPAA is not itself a formal certification.

last_funding.notes: Reported October 10, 2025; led by Sierra Ventures.

raised_18mo.notes: The $22 million Series A reported October 10, 2025 falls within the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The reviewed job board lists only the AI research role, with no qualifying SDR, BDR or account executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: Eden introduced Cortex on October 14, 2026, describing medical-image understanding and complete diagnostic-report generation.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A March 2, 2026 announcement reports the hiring of radiologist Felipe Kitamura as Chief Medical Officer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable API documentation and job listing reviewed name no CRM or sales/marketing systems.
